$description: THE central allowlist for audit:debt (spec specs/audit-debt, 2026-07-27). One entry per deliberate exception. Every entry REQUIRES a written reason and a date, and the audit prints the count on every run so this file can never be silent or scattered. There are no inline skip comments and no per-element attributes anywhere; CLAUDE.md section 9 bans those and this does not reopen the hole, because it is capped: the audit FAILS above maxEntries, and FAILS on any entry older than staleAfterDays without being re-dated. Growth is self-limiting and stale exemptions surface themselves.
